commits.subject: score-plugin: process-isolated plugin host (IsolatedHost, framed worker protocol, deadline/cancel/crash reclaim, admission permits, process ledger, lifecycle + state versioning, PluginProcessor over score Engine, reference gain/delay worker; CLAP NOT_PROVEN)

capabilities_done: Port + lifecycle (off-callback): PluginProvider (probe, activate) and PluginInstance (process / process_expecting, set_parameter, capture_state, last_fault, retire); ApprovedPlugin{path, content_sha256, format, arch, abi_version} + PluginGrant{actor, content_sha256} (no path without hash and grant; no discovery, no registry); LifecycleState Discovered/Probed/Active/Processing/Draining/Retired with checked transitions (IllegalTransition); typed PluginError (unauthorized, hash_mismatch, abi_mismatch, probe_timeout, crashed{exit_code}, timeout, stale_state, budget_exceeded, canceled, protocol(fault), illegal_transition, unavailable, invalid_config, invalid_block, non_finite_output)

Framed worker protocol (src/wire.rs, std only): header u32 magic 'HSPK' + u16 version + u8 kind + u32 length (11 bytes), length checked against the cap BEFORE allocation, payload read incrementally; HELLO first from the worker; request ids echoed by replies; planar f32 blocks with explicit frames/channels (frames <= score MAX_BLOCK_FRAMES, channels <= MAX_CHANNELS); garbage, version skew, unknown kind, oversize, truncated and id-mismatch are distinct protocol faults; every strict prefix of every message is rejected (unit test)

IsolatedHost (src/host.rs): never loads foreign code; spawns the worker with env_clear, null stderr, piped stdio and CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows; I/O thread per worker + 5 ms wait slices polling cancel and the wall-clock deadline; deadline -> kill+reap (Timeout, ProbeTimeout while spawning/probing/configuring); cancel -> kill+reap (Canceled); end of stream -> Crashed{exit_code} after EXIT_PATIENCE; protocol faults kill+reap; output block gets silence on every failure (FaultReport{error, killed, reaped, exit_code, safe_output}); Session::drop kills+reaps so any error path after the child exists reaps it (PLATFORM-12); Draining instance accepts only retire

Admission: HostLimits{max_workers, max_in_flight_bytes (2 x block bytes + max_state_bytes per instance), max_frame_bytes, max_plugin_file_bytes, spawn_timeout, shutdown_grace}; RAII Permit acquired without waiting (BudgetExceeded at once, partial acquisition released) and released only after the reap; host-owned process ledger (owner_session from the grant actor, started_unix_ms, pid, killed, reaped, exit_code) and HostStats counters

Authorization order before any spawn: cancel, deadline bounds, grant present and naming the same hash (Unauthorized), host arch + format Clap + abi (AbiMismatch), config bounds, permit (BudgetExceeded), bounded file read + SHA-256 compare (HashMismatch / Unavailable); the worker re-hashes the file before use

State versioning (STU-ARC-021 shape): state_version bound to the instance id; process_expecting(v) refuses a block prepared under an older version (StaleState, nothing written); set_parameter bumps the version; capture_state(max_bytes) returns a versioned Complete|Partial|Unavailable snapshot bounded by max_bytes; process receipts carry completeness

PluginProcessor: score Processor over a PluginInstance so the score Engine admits, publishes or discards the block (a failed or canceled plugin block is never published); typed error kept in take_error(); score outcome mapping documented
report(result, correlation_id, revision, cancel, Observe, SinkPort) with outcome_of: Success / Canceled / Failure(Validation | Loss | Unavailable); no plugin path or sample data attached

Reference worker bin score-plugin-worker (pure-Rust gain + real sample delay, parameter 0 = gain, state = gain) with test-only faults via HostOptions.test_args: crash-on-block=N, hang-on-block=N, garbage-on-block=N, oversize-on-block=N, short-on-block=N, hang-on-probe, partial-state, no-state, --latency N; panic hook exits 70 and injected crashes exit 86 (no platform crash dialog)

DESCRIPTOR (proof_status labels CLAP/VST3/OS resource caps NOT_PROVEN) and example consumer score-plugin-consumer (--descriptor, --worker PATH --gain G --frames N --latency L --crash-on N --hang-on N --deadline-ms MS)

design_notes.trait_deviation: Brief signature PluginProvider::probe(p, d) gained grant + cancel parameters and activate(cfg) gained cancel + deadline (the grant is the Unauthorized gate; cancel/deadline are per call). PluginInstance::process gained cancel + deadline and writes into a score OutputBlock (the Engine publishes).
design_notes.retire: PluginInstance::retire(self: Box<Self>) delegates to IsolatedInstance::retire_in_place (non-consuming, idempotent) so illegal-after-retire calls are testable.
design_notes.reference_worker: The approved plugin file is hashed (host before spawn, worker before use) but never executed or loaded; the reference backend is a pure-Rust gain/delay processor.
design_notes.bin_target: score-plugin-worker is a [[bin]] without required-features so integration tests get CARGO_BIN_EXE_score-plugin-worker; the optional native CLAP backend will be added to the same worker behind feature clap.
design_notes.ids: instance ids are per host starting at 1; request ids per instance starting at 1.
design_notes.reset_limit: PluginProcessor::reset is a no-op: when the Engine discards a block the foreign plugin history has advanced and is not rewound (documented).
